title: Egyptian Beef Sirloin Steak Croute
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the tenderness of beef sirloin steak with the crunch of Egyptian puffed pastry croute.
instructions: Season the sirloin steak with Flaky Salt and Quick Fix Spice Blend.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the steak to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the steak in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the steak is cooking, roll out the Egyptian puffed pastry croute to a large rectangle.
Once the steak is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Place the croute on top of the steak and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the croute is golden brown.
Remove the steak from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
